name: NEMO x402 Micro-Services
description: Twenty-four pay-per-call agent micro-services at agentx.sale, settled on-chain via x402 (USDC on Base + Solana) or the IETF Machine Payments Protocol (MPP); Stripe cards on $1+ routes. Free MCP catalogue and x402 Doctor at https://agentx.sale/x402/mcp.

payment_details.x402: v2, PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, USDC on Base (payTo 0x9702dDF83ECB770f87FF6AF04156Be7241a3fe83) and Solana (payTo CL4gJQMCuBNLoRPdbEgwdRkyH6RLC2Eak6yombja4vD9)
payment_details.mpp: IETF Machine Payments Protocol — WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge (evm/charge via the Coinbase facilitator), Authorization: Payment credential, Payment-Receipt on every settled call
payment_details.stripe: Shared Payment Token card flow on routes priced $1 and above (Stripe card minimum makes penny routes wallet-only)

authentication.description: No authentication required for discovery. Payment verification uses on-chain signatures (x402/MPP) or Stripe Shared Payment Tokens.
